# 🎇This is The Unfathon SMP MODPACK🎇
## A _(soft)_ hardcore multiplayer server Like The Unstable SMP

This modpack provides the essentials to playing the Unfathon Unstable SMP

- Having The Unstable Generation mod (only version 1.2)
- ukus armor hud
- Shield fixer (only version 1.2)
- And more to make your time playing the server way better
